1. `origin/feature/analytics-forecast-showrate` (c2c4685) — analytics: revenue forecast + show rate. Touches AnalyticsService.cs, IAnalyticsService.cs, new ForecastShowRateDto.cs, AnalyticsController.cs, admin/analytics.astro. DISJOINT from the others — should merge clean.
2. `origin/feature/pos-split-payments` (ce913fb) — POS split payments. Touches new PaymentSplitLine.cs, ISchedulingService.cs, SchedulingService.cs (CollectStudioPaymentAsync), InvoiceController.cs, SchedulingController.cs, admin/ClassDetailPanel.astro (checkout modal split UI).
3. `origin/feature/class-duo-attendee-qty` (5d4e9b4) — duo private + attendee-quantity stepper. Touches SchedulingService.cs, ISchedulingService.cs, SchedulingController.cs, admin/ClassDetailPanel.astro (roster stepper).

## Conflict resolution: UNION — keep EVERY feature
Branches 2 and 3 both edit `SchedulingService.cs`, `ISchedulingService.cs`, `SchedulingController.cs`, and `ClassDetailPanel.astro`, but in DIFFERENT places (POS = the checkout/payment path + checkout modal; class = AdjustAttendeeQuantity/duo + roster stepper). Resolve by KEEPING BOTH:

- `SchedulingService.cs`: keep CollectStudioPaymentAsync's per-tender Payment rows AND AdjustAttendeeQuantityAsync + the duo-capacity changes in AdminAddStudentAsync/RemoveAttendanceAsync.
- `SchedulingController.cs`: keep the CollectBookingPaymentRequest.PaymentSplits passthrough AND the new PATCH attendee-quantity endpoint.
- `ClassDetailPanel.astro`: keep the "+ Split payment" checkout UI AND the `− [n] +` roster stepper — they're different sections, keep both.
Never drop a feature to resolve a conflict. After resolving, sanity-check all five features' code is present and coherent.

- `astro build` (`npm ci && npm run build`) in `node:22-alpine --rm` → MUST succeed (0 errors, ~59 pages).
If a real integration bug surfaces, fix it minimally and note it.

## Finish
- Commit + push `integration/sp-ideas-batch` to origin (verify the push stuck — the box has automation that can reset branches; re-push if needed).
- Do NOT merge to main / deploy / build deploy-images / restart.
- Remove the worktree when done (`git worktree remove /opt/soulpilates-wt-integ --force`; prune). Clean up any helper scripts on /opt/nxeon.

Report: the integration branch + tip commit, every conflict resolved and how, confirmation dotnet + astro both build clean, a checklist confirming all 5 features present (revenue forecast, show rate, split payments, duo private, attendee-quantity stepper), and the note that deploy = a normal backend+frontend image rebuild (no migration).
